items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I had a brother, Frank, who was about two years older than I am, he liked music, and he took the violin.

ctx.x: One of those little bitty horns.

Yes. They called them cornets then. They didn't call none of those horns... In fact, I didn't know anything about a trumpet in those days. I think they called all of them cornets. And he fooled around with the harmonica. But he wanted all of us children to learn music. My older brother gave the violin a shot, and he didn't care about it nothin'; but I had a brother, Frank, who was about two years older than I am, he liked music, and he took the violin.
I wanted to ask you what was your first instrument exactly.
